title: North Texas rainfall, August 21–22, 2022

event.title: North Texas rainfall, August 21–22, 2022
event.domain_note: North/Central Texas is a provisional region selected for this package. Bounds may be edited before build.

comparison_design: Frozen 0.25-degree ANN-CSGD and full-CONUS GNN-CSGD compared with raw HRRR and duration-matched MRMS at common points. The ANN models at other predictor resolutions are not included.
scope: 2022 overlaps the published model training period. These maps and scores are retrospective training-period diagnostics, not independent test skill. North/Central Texas is a provisional region selected for this package. Bounds may be edited before build. Only the declared initialization cycles and valid-end interval are included. Windows overlap and scores are descriptive.
focus_selection: Maximum MRMS fraction above 2 inches in an available 24-hour window; tie by observed maximum and stable ID. Use the same initialization and valid end for all three durations. Observation-selected diagnostic.

method.units: Internal amounts and score downloads in mm; map precipitation in inches.
method.spatial_support: Identical original 0.25-degree land sample points within each window for every model.
method.temporal_support: Exact 6/12/24-hour windows; overlapping windows are dependent.
method.crps: Analytic CSGD CRPS including shift times squared mass at zero.
method.training: Frozen checkpoints; original training objective retained, no refitting for these case plots.
method.inference: Full-CONUS predictors and full GNN graph before regional extraction.
method.uncertainty: Descriptive storm diagnostics; no significance test or general model ranking.
method.case_selection: Event dates specified by user; focus window selected with MRMS observations.

map_update.spatial_support: Original 0.25-degree point samples; no added resolution
map_update.hover: Exact saved axes and original array values
